newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar firms as dollar sales increase.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar firms as dollar sales increase.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed slightly firmer at 475.00/476.00 per dollar Monday, compared to 475.25/476.25 per dollar Friday, due to higher dollar sales by corporate clients and the Central Bank, dealers said.

Traders said foreign currency buying in the morning sent the exchange rate higher than Friday's close but that dollar sales by one large multinational and the Central bank brought the rate lower late in the session.
Traders said they expected the exchange rate to remain little changed through the rest of the week.
